prompt: Generate a recurring meeting series: find the first matching weekday on or after the start, step forward every N weeks, and drop cancelled dates without shifting the rhythm.
explanation: Two separate steps make this manageable: first align the start onto the requested day of week, then repeat a fixed stride. Advancing with plusWeeks(everyNWeeks) rather than recomputing from the original date keeps the series on the same weekday and lets LocalDate handle month and year rollovers for free. The cancellation rule is the subtle part -- skipping a date must not consume a slot in the rhythm, so the candidate still advances by the full stride even when nothing was added to the result.
hints: Step the candidate forward one day at a time until candidate.getDayOfWeek() == dayOfWeek; at most six steps are ever needed.
Advance the candidate at the END of every pass of the loop, whether or not you kept it -- that is what makes a cancellation a hole rather than a shift.
Loop while dates.size() < count, and keep a separate counter so a series that cancels everything still stops after 500 candidates.
